description: NightGuide — worldwide nightclub discovery. Browse clubs city by city: hours, DJ lineups, dress codes, entry rules, and prices. Static web app, Capacitor native wrapper.
name: nightguide

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js styles.css privacy.html terms.html www/ && cp -r data www/ && echo www built
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
